This is the blog for Data-Centric Engineering (cambridge.org/dce), an open-access journal at the interface of engineering and data science. 

#### Editors in chief
Alice Cicirello (University of Cambridge) and Luca Magri (Imperial College London). 

#### Executive editors
Sez Atamturktur (Clemson University), Stéphane Bordas (University of Luxembourg), Lawrence Bull (University of Glasgow), Gao Cong (Nanyang Technological University), Elizabeth Cross (University of Sheffield), Liang Gao (Huazhong University of Science and Technology), Roger Ghanem (University of Southern California), Benjamin Guedj (University College London and Inria), Wayne Jones (Shell), Visakan Kadirkamanathan (University of Sheffield), Eiman Kanjo (Nottingham Trent University), Jane Macfarlane (University of California Berkeley), Pradipta Maji (Indian Statistical Institute), Omar Matar (Imperial College London), Jiang Yan Shao (Wuhan University of Technology), Brian Sheil (University of Cambridge), Sumeetpal Singh (University of Wollongong), Adam Sobey (University of Southampton and The Alan Turing Institute), Hae Young-Noh (Stanford University), Jize Zhang (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology).

####

Blog edited by [Tina Dardeno](https://sheffield.ac.uk/mac/people/research-staff/tina-dardeno) (University of Sheffield) and co-edited by [Lawrence Bull](https://labull.github.io) (University of Glasgow).

---

The views expressed in this blog are those of the listed author, they do not represent the formal view of the DCE team.
